d: Some of the strangest fish stories begin with a sighting nobody can explain. Jeremy Wade follows reports of unusual aquatic creatures, giant catches and mysterious predators across some of the world's most intriguing waterways. From a giant Pacific halibut in Alaska and a seven-foot wels catfish to the elusive Dusky Carp and the Giant Pike Menace, each investigation raises fresh questions. He also examines killer whales hunting salmon and encounters remarkable fish around Lake Garda and the Fitzroy River.
